# Kyoto 6-Day Trip Plan: April 10–15, 2026

A balanced route for **2 adults** with a **USD 1,800 sightseeing budget** excludes flights, keeps each day under **12 km walking**, and mixes temples, food, and one dedicated half-day for shopping. Costs below are estimated for **2 adults total per day**.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan

| Day | Focus | Main Stops | Est. Walking | Est. Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 — Apr 10 | Higashiyama welcome day | Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Yasaka Shrine, Gion dinner walk | 7–9 km | USD 210 |
| Day 2 — Apr 11 | Arashiyama + riverside | Tenryu-ji, Bamboo Grove, Okochi Sanso area, riverfront lunch | 8–10 km | USD 260 |
| Day 3 — Apr 12 | Central Kyoto temples + food | Nishiki Market, Kyoto Imperial Palace area, Nijo Castle, Pontocho dinner | 6–8 km | USD 230 |
| Day 4 — Apr 13 | Fushimi Inari + sake district | Fushimi Inari Taisha, Tofuku-ji, Fushimi sake tasting | 8–11 km | USD 240 |
| Day 5 — Apr 14 | Half-day shopping + relaxed culture | Kyoto Station area, Shijo/Kawaramachi shopping, tea stop, evening temple stroll | 5–7 km | USD 280 |
| Day 6 — Apr 15 | Northern Kyoto finale | Kinkaku-ji, Ryoan-ji, lunch in Kinugasa, departure buffer | 7–9 km | USD 260 |

## Day-by-Day Route Details

### Day 1: Higashiyama Welcome Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, then start at **Kiyomizu-dera** for classic Kyoto views.
- Afternoon: Walk downhill through **Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka** and stop for matcha sweets or tofu lunch.
- Evening: Visit **Yasaka Shrine** and finish with dinner in **Gion**.
- Food: Try **yudofu**, yuba, or a kaiseki-style set meal.
- Cost estimate: Temples/entry USD 20, food USD 110, local transport USD 20, snacks/coffee USD 20, buffer USD 40.

### Day 2: Arashiyama + Riverside
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Start early at **Tenryu-ji** and the **Bamboo Grove** before crowds build.
- Afternoon: Explore the **Okochi Sanso** area or take a slow riverside walk near Togetsukyo Bridge.
- Evening: Have a relaxed dinner back in central Kyoto.
- Food: Look for **soba**, grilled river fish, or a tofu lunch set.
- Cost estimate: Entry/garden fees USD 30, food USD 120, transport USD 30, coffee/snacks USD 20, buffer USD 60.

### Day 3: Central Kyoto Temples + Market Food
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Browse **Nishiki Market** for tasting stops and small bites.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning: Browse **Nishiki Market** for tasting stops and small bites, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Visit the **Kyoto Imperial Palace** area, then continue to **Nijo Castle**.
- Evening: Dinner in **Pontocho** or nearby downtown lanes.
- Food: Build a lunch from market snacks, then choose a noodle or tempura dinner.
- Cost estimate: Entry USD 25, food USD 120, transport USD 20, market tasting USD 35, buffer USD 30.

### Day 4: Fushimi Inari + Sake District
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Go early to **Fushimi Inari Taisha** and walk a shorter portion of the torii trail.
- Afternoon: Visit **Tofuku-ji** if energy is good, then move to **Fushimi** for sake culture.
- Evening: Sake tasting and dinner in the Fushimi area or back in Kyoto center.
- Food: Pair a light lunch with **sake-friendly izakaya** dishes at night.
- Cost estimate: Entry USD 10, food USD 120, transport USD 30, tastings USD 50, buffer USD 30.

### Day 5: Half-Day Shopping + Easy Culture
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Keep this as your **shopping half-day** around **Kyoto Station**, **Shijo**, and **Kawaramachi**.
- Afternoon: Add a tea break, then visit a nearby temple or garden at a slower pace.
- Evening: Choose a final nice dinner and an optional short stroll.
- Food: Use this day for café stops, sweets, and a celebratory dinner.
- Cost estimate: Shopping allowance USD 120, food USD 110, transport USD 20, tea/café USD 20, buffer USD 10.

### Day 6: Northern Kyoto Finale
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/snow.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kinkaku-ji** early for a quieter start.
- Afternoon: Continue to **Ryoan-ji** and have lunch nearby in Kinugasa.
- Evening: Keep the last evening flexible for packing, a final dessert, or airport transfer.
- Food: Try a simple seasonal lunch and one last Kyoto dessert.
- Cost estimate: Entry USD 15, food USD 110, transport USD 30, snacks USD 15, buffer USD 90.

## Budget Fit for 2 Adults

- **Total estimated sightseeing spend:** **USD 1,480**
- **Budget remaining:** **USD 320**
- This leaves room for extra shopping, higher-end dinners, or a taxi on a tired day.
- Walking stays in the target range by grouping sights by neighborhood and using short transit hops between areas.
